However, while plastic has many benefits, it also causes lots of problems. Some plastic |
is so strong that it takes more than 400 years to break down before returning safely to
the environment. When plastic is put in a landfill, the harmful materials inside can get
into the soil and water underground. When plastic rubbish is burnt, it fills the air with
harmful gas. Another problem is that plastic rubbish is often thrown on the ground.
Rain washes that rubbish into the rivers. From there, it is swept out to the sea. Sea
animals can get caught in it or hurt by it. Worse yet, sometimes fish eat the plastic as
food, and it gets into their bodies. When the fish get to our dining table, the plastic
would get into humans’ bodies and harm our health.
What can we do about this problem? The best solution, for now, is to use less plastic.
